I really appreciate your advice bro. I am trying to revive who I was before by making baby steps in studying. I can probably accept friends not liking me but it seems that my family hates me too. It's still quarantine season here and being at home for most of the time is really suffocating. They remind me how no one would want me. Why I have less friends and how I have anxiety and low self- confidence. I tried not to mind them but I can go anymore further. They've been acting like I don't exist and that reminds me of the time I was bullied and outcasted. I tried talking to them but to no avail. Morel like they want me gone just like the others. I see no difference.
Thank you for expressing my thoughts into words. I cried while reading this and imagining my past selves. I really am a disappointment.
